description: Use to combine two recordings of one workout: a watch or bike computer plus a heart-rate-only recording that overlaps it, or a device plus a virtual-platform recording of one indoor ride. Works out which file is the base and the clock offset (pass offsetSec only if the user knows it) and previews what the single merge step will change, including the heart rate it would take from the other file. If the other file does not cover the start or end of the base, it also offers one optional crop step (never ticked) that cuts the result to the time both recorded. Merges have been checked on a limited set of device combinations; other combinations have not been tested, so tell the user to look at the result. Two activities, in any order. If they do not overlap but follow each other, use analyze_interrupted_workout. Nothing is changed by this call, and nothing that alters heart rate or any other data is applied without the user's confirmation. Show the user every step whose needsUserConfirmation is true, with its title, reason and changes, and get an explicit yes; then call apply_plan with exactly the confirmed step ids. Relay findings and notes in plain words. If refusal is set, tell the user why and do not offer a workaround the answer does not give.

activityIds.description: The two recordings of one workout (for example a watch file and a heart-rate strap file), in any order.

offsetSec.description: Seconds to add to the clock of activityIds[1]. Omit to let the server estimate it.

name: analyze_dual_recording
